comments.comment: Patrick-Bot: Reviewed on master c9ebe940b1. Rainshadow shows 36 failures of sanity-quota test_55, all in the b2_12 server vs b2_11 client interop sessions (last 2021-10-03); none on master or any other config since. The interop version check from LU-10722 (change 31531, MDS1_VERSION >= 2.10.58) is on master and the chgrp quota enforcement (LU-5152) is in b2_11 and later. The b2_12 vs b2_11 interop pairing no longer runs in CI, so no live failure exists to fix on master. Not reproduced on ltvm (no 2.11.0 client build available), so leaving this open for a human to decide whether to close it as stale/won't fix.
